title: Brush Set 6 Pieces – Soft Brushes for Car, Boat & Home
descriptionHtml:
Reach every nook – without scratching

Vents, rims, seams and tight corners are almost impossible to get clean with a cloth. And the wrong brush can easily scratch paint and delicate surfaces.

Six brushes for all surfaces

The set contains six soft brushes in different sizes with an extension attachment. The soft bristles clean effectively without damaging paint, upholstery or plastic. Perfect for car, boat, shoes, kitchen and windows.

Features

  • Six brushes in different sizes for all surfaces
  • Soft bristles that don't scratch paint and plastic
  • Extension attachment for hard-to-reach places
  • For car, boat, seats, mats, shoes and windows
  • Comfortable grips that make cleaning easier

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
